preconditions.description: The input integer n satisfies 1 <= n <= 10^3.

postconditions.description: The number of knights in the output is exactly n.

postconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= x <= 10**9 and -10**9 <= y <= 10**9 for x, y in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each knight's coordinates (x, y) satisfy -10^9 <= x <= 10^9 and -10^9 <= y <= 10^9.
All knights are in different cells, i.e., all coordinates are unique.

postconditions.expression: len(set(tuple(knight) for knight in return_value)) >= int(stdin.split()[0])**2 // 10
postconditions.description: The final number of knights is at least floor(n^2 / 10).
